purpose: functional verification of forking a sandbox at another size on KVM; the times are the check's own stopwatch and not a benchmark

cases.name: forks at another size boot at it, with the source's variables and not its memory
a fork with no size is its source's size, with its memory
a fork at its template's size is restored from it, and pauses with its memory
a fork of a sandbox with a disk, at another size, has its own copy of the disk
a fork's usage is counted at its own size
a size that cannot be is refused, and no fork is made

refused.no processors: cpuCount 0: between 1 and 24, this host's CPUs
refused.more processors than the host: cpuCount 4096: between 1 and 24, this host's CPUs
refused.too little memory: memoryMB 128: an even number from 256 to 65536
refused.an odd amount: memoryMB 1023: an even number from 256 to 65536
